notes.title: QUANTAAR NEW SEASON：VEGAS SHOWDOWN
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377468/f96f35cdba0091ed060d2de897c69500534740f6.png[/img]

New Update Highlights:
🏆 Ranked Matchmaking Overhaul:
Get ready for a more competitive and authentic gaming experience with our revamped Ranked Matchmaking system. Say goodbye to AI opponents in your pursuit of glory! We've eliminated the practice of quick AI matchups to ensure that every battle in the ranked arena is against skilled human opponents.

🔄 Extended Queue Wait Times:
In our commitment to delivering a fair and challenging competitive environment, we've made adjustments to the queue system. While the elimination of AI matchups enhances the authenticity of ranked battles, it comes with the trade-off of slightly extended wait times. Rest assured, the extended wait is an investment in the quality of your gaming experience.

🤖 Why the Change?
By removing AI opponents from the ranked matchmaking pool, we aim to create a more competitive and skill-based environment. This change ensures that each ranked match is a true test of your abilities against fellow players who are equally determined to climb the ranks.

🔗 Quick Login Feature:
For our registered players, logging into the game is now faster and smoother than ever. Enjoy a streamlined login experience that gets you into the action in no time, allowing you to focus on what you love – gaming!

🔊 Default Volume Adjustments:
We've fine-tuned the default audio settings for an enhanced gaming experience. The game's default volume is now set at 70, providing a balanced auditory experience, while voice volume is increased to 95, ensuring clear communication with your teammates.

🌐 Feedback Matters:
As always, we value your feedback and strive to make improvements that enhance your gaming satisfaction. Share your thoughts on these changes, and stay tuned for more updates as we continue to refine and elevate your VR gaming experience.

🔥New Season Highlights 🔥

SEASON DURATION : 2024 2/7~4/3 2024/02/07 5:00 PM (UTC +8) ~ 2024/04/03 4:59 PM (UTC +8).

👥 2 Hero Skins:
Step into the arena with style by unlocking not one, but TWO epic hero skins. Whether you're a seasoned pro or a fresh face, these skins will set you apart from the competition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377468/3f2619e28545ffb798c7bb6e075bb6dc6313974b.png[/img]

👀 9 Observer Skins:
Become the eye in the sky with our collection of 9 mesmerizing observer skins. From sleek and futuristic designs to eye-catching motifs, choose the one that suits your taste and elevate your spectator game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377468/1285f16951b6af688f2dcc329c38d330c9309cc7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377468/6a3e35bc7f0177bb4f4799e67f899dfc9e687298.png[/img]

🎭 7 Avatars:
Make a statement with 7 unique avatars that reflect your gaming persona. Whether you prefer an air of mystery or want to showcase your vibrant personality, these avatars will be the perfect addition to your VR identity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377468/81d144812a7dc6cc6dc21be356a519cec13fa40e.png[/img]

🏆 Compete, Collect, Conquer:
Whether you're a QUANTAAR veteran or a newcomer to the scene, the fourth season is your chance to shine. Compete in intense battles, collect exclusive rewards, and conquer the VEGAS SHOWDOWN leaderboard.

Get ready to roll the dice, embrace the neon glow, and dive into the immersive world of VEGAS SHOWDOWN. The fourth season promises excitement, rewards, and a gaming experience like no other. Let the VEGAS SHOWDOWN begin! 

🐞 Bug Fixes:

⚽ Football Mode Ball Collision Fix:

The issue where the ball in Football Mode was not responding to hits properly has been resolved. Get ready for a seamless and exhilarating football experience within the game!
🎯 Game Mission Completion Fix:

Some game missions were proving to be elusive, but fear not – we've squashed those bugs! Now, all players can complete their missions and reap the rewards they deserve.
🤖 DIGI's Robot Vanishing Act Fix:

No need to worry about uninvited robotic guests sticking around – DIGI's robot will now vanish as intended.

notes.title: HALLOWEEN PUMPKIN FESTIVAL
notes.content:
Dive into the festive fervor of the season with our spooktacular event, Halloween Pumpkin Festival! Get ready for a ghoulishly good time as we bring you a series of thrilling activities that promise to add a dash of Halloween magic to your gaming experience.


[u][b]EVENT DURATION:[/b][/u]

2023/10/25 5:00 PM (UTC +8) ~ 2023/11/5 4:59 PM (UTC +8).

 
[u][b]EVENT DETAILS:[/b][/u]

[h3]Casual Mode: Pumpkin Bounty Battles![/h3]
Embark on a pumpkin-filled adventure during Casual Mode battles where a mysterious Pumpkin Chest will spawn every 30 seconds. Attack the chest to reveal 15-30 random Pumpkin Candies. Gather these candies and aim to collect a maximum of 100 Pumpkin Candies daily using this spine-tingling method.

[h3] Party Hall: Pumpkin Extravaganza![/h3]

Join Party Halls, where random Pumpkin Chests will make a surprise appearance. Approach these mystical Pumpkin Chests to obtain 5-20 random Pumpkin Candies. Seize the opportunity to collect up to 100 Pumpkin Candies daily through this bewitching method.
 

Pumpkin Candy Reward List: 
[tr]    [th]Pumpkin Candies[/th]    [th]Rewards[/th]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][u]200[/u][/td]    [td][u]1,000 Star Coins[/u][/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][u]400[/u][/td]    [td][u]Profile - Mummy[/u][/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][u]600[/u][/td]    [td][u]1,000 Star Coins[/u][/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][u]800[/u][/td]    [td][u]Profile - Vampire Coffin[/u][/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][u]1000[/u][/td]    [td][u]1,000 Star Coins[/u][/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][u]1200[/u][/td]    [td][u]Profile - Halloween Pumpkin Head[/u][/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][u]1400[/u][/td]    [td][u]Captain Fury Style - Mystic Ocean[/u][/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][u]1600[/u][/td]    [td][u]Observer Style (Hands) [/u]
[u]Mummy Hands (Amethyst)[/u][/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][u]1800[/u][/td]    [td][u]Analog Style - Mystic Lolita[/u][/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][u]2000[/u][/td]    [td][u]Observer Style (Head) [/u]
[u]Halloween Pumpkin Head[/u][/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][u]2200[/u][/td]    [td][u]500 Galaxy Gems[/u][/td]  [/tr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377468/61abe14f85f7daaaaf603bbb4f76ad3481376303.png[/img]
[i]Check back at "Event" tab to keep track of the amount of Pumpkin Candies collected.[/i]

[h3]Halloween Costume Party: Golden King of Disguise![/h3]

Reign supreme in the art of disguise at our Halloween Costume Party! Unleash your creativity and showcase your most enchanting and mysterious costumes. Embrace the challenge to become the Golden King of Disguise in a night filled with surprises and eerie elegance. The Halloween Exclusive Costume Party will be available for a limited time with available items: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377468/86d0a99336e4c56c69a2106d6093319b150cf7da.png[/img]

[i]From left to right: Captain Fury Skin - Terror of the Deep, Analog Skin - Goth Girl, Observer Cosmetic - Jack'O Lantern , Observer Cosmetics - Golden Mummy Hands (Ruby) [/i]

[h3]Brand NEW Arena: Candy Volcano[/h3]

Behold a NEW arena Cany Volcano available for our Premium players in Custom Mode! Fight on cakes within the volcano of the Candy Kingdom, and enjoy the various appearances of these cakes. However, be cautious, as your attacks may damage the cakes. Engage in an exciting battle in this sweet arena!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377468/d9ec6cd768ae2c8b31c56102018673c54e39100b.png[/img]


Gear up for an unforgettable Halloween gaming experience and collect Pumpkin Candies to unlock exclusive in-game rewards. May your costumes be haunting, and your Pumpkin Candies plentiful! 

Join us for the Halloween Pumpkin Festival – where the magic of Halloween comes alive in every battle and celebration in this limited time only!

notes.title: New Patch - V.01.103
notes.content:
[h1][b]V.01.103[/b][/h1]

[h2][u]HERO UPDATES[/u][/h2]
[b]FLÈCHE[/b]
Modified Flèche's dash skill
[list]
[*]From complete Invisibility to Stealth. You will be able to have a slight visual on the outline of Flèche instead of complete invisibility. 
[/list]
[b]ANALOG[/b]
Modified the range and duration of Analog’s Super Move:
[list]
[*] Super Move’s Range reduced from 1200 -> 800,
[*] Skill effectiveness duration reduced 3s -> 1.2s
[/list]
[b]QUASAR[/b]
Modified the duration of Quasar’s Ultimate
[list]
[*] Skill duration reduced from 18 s -> 15 s
[*] Skill per hit damage reduced from 500 -> 100
[/list]

[h2][u]UI OPTIMIZATIONS[/u][/h2]
Modified the text message for purchasing Tickets in the Season Board
[list]
[*] Modified the AI behavior in practice mode so that the AI no longer performs jump attacks when jumping setting is disabled.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused the social room to appear when it's empty.
[*] Resolved the bug where the player's seasonal rank was displayed incorrectly.
[*] Fixed the bug that occasionally fails to matchmake when players are in the Social Halls.
[*] Addressed the bug where Plasma and Elemont's skin was displayed incorrectly.
[*] Corrected the inconsistency in text capitalization on the UI.
[*] Fixed the bug where Seasonal missions appeared "blank".
[*] Resolved the issue where the camera got stuck inside the Observer at the start of a battle.
[*] Optimized the lighting in the arenas to improve visual experience.
[*] Enhanced the matchmaking system to reduce the chances of matching errors.
[*] Fixed the issue of duplicated UID for different players.
[/list]

[h2][u]NEW ADDED FEATURES[/u][/h2]
New features, Hero View settings added - Players can now select if they want to automatically switch to Observer mode when opening the menu during a battle.
[list]
[*] When enabled, players will be in the Hero Action View by default when entering a battle. When disabled, players will remain in the Observer View by default when entering a battle.
[*] Previously, the views do not automatically switch back. But now, during battles, players will switch to the Observer view automatically when opening the Wrist Menu in battle, regardless of their current Observer or Hero Action perspective.
[/list]

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/4fUdySfNBX]Discord[/url] for instant notifications and to meet other players!

notes.title: QUANTAAR, the VR Party Brawler is Coming for Free-to-play on June 7, 2023
notes.content:
Greetings Observers!

Mark the date! After years of development, we are thrilled to announce that [b]QUANTAAR[/b] is set to launch on [u]June 7, 2023[/u] as a Free-to-play on Meta Quest 2, Steam, and PICO 4. 

Command dimensionally displaced heroes with distinct class-based roles including Fighter, Assassin, Generalist and Shooter. Beef up your chosen hero’s agility, fire and range with Cores to bash it out across a variety of adrenaline-pumping game modes like Brawler, 2v2 and Soccer, and earn in-game tokens to purchase new heroes, cosmetic skins and costumes for your avatar. 


Witness universes collide and clash in QUANTAAR’s release date announcement trailer: 

[previewyoutube=oKoWk1M2YVE;full][/previewyoutube]

As players immerse themselves further in the Quantaarverse, they’ll quickly memorize class attributes, learn to outfit their heroes’ four Core slots wisely, and balance their teams to maintain a consistent edge in battle. Expertly time hero ultimate abilities and grow to master each of the game’s modes to reign supreme on the ranking each season.

The party doesn’t stop there! Continue the party with your friends or meet new players in our themed social rooms like Playground and Transport Hub to start an air basketball game, climb rocks, play bowling or just hang out in the lounge bar before heading into the next multiversal melee.

[b]Key Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Master heroes with unique class attributes to win in-game rewards – then get new ones!
[*] Enhance your hero with Cores and experiment with millions of combinations
[*] Multiple arenas with diverse mechanics and items that assault contestants mid-battle
[*] Three action-packed game modes: Brawler, 2v2, and Soccer
[*] Personal space station to relax before the next rumble
[*] Huge social hubs to meet new friends and party
[*] Limited edition cosmetic skins and Observer accessories to always look fresh in the arena
[/list]


Share this exciting news with your friends and [url=https://quantaar.com/wishlist]wishlist QUANTAAR[/url] on your preferable platform.
For more information, come visit our [url=https://quantaar.com]website[/url] and join [url=https://discord.gg/W6fDQEYGg7]Discord[/url] to meet other players!

Love from Pumpkin VR!

notes.title: Quantaar SteamVR Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
We have liftoff!

After 3 years behind-the-scenes, and a slight delay due to unforeseen circumstances, we’re delighted to announce that Quantaar’s very first SteamVR Demo Week has launched, from now till November 9th!

Step into the multiverse and enjoy our action-packed, out-of-this-world experience, where the fighting possibilities are limitless.

[previewyoutube=MPalHWRhNP0;full][/previewyoutube]
Become an Observer and choose from 4 heroes, using them to knock opponents off the arena floor, bomb them into the air, and develop your unique play style. Compete in thrilling matches and enjoy the mesmerizing, yet challenging arenas on offer.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1448350/Quantaar/
                    
The Demo includes:

A tutorial/walkthrough that will teach you about Quantaar, the multiverse, and much more, before diving in.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40377468/891635846b88f169f0e4d07c51f308c3bc0b9f03.png[/img]

The choice of 4 power-packed heroes (with more to come to post-Demo). Note: In the “2v2” mode, if players choose “Quick matching” it can only accommodate 2 players (pair with 2 bots) or 4 players. There's no option for 3 players and 1 bot. They include: 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40377468/01dd939e029c02976336586b54fcf5a8a0c2d4dd.png[/img]

2 challenging Arenas, Quantaar Arena, and Dragon Valley! Quantaar Arena is THE place for trying out Quantaar first, before experiencing Dragon Valley with its PVE components.

Note: There’s a low (but still possible) chance that players can’t add/see/match with their friends due to the re-allocation of the server. If you can’t see/add/invite your friends in the game, please try to quit and rejoin the game together.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40377468/cc656a020c7f890927bc113ee81ab879bb4fa19d.png[/img]

A variety of gaming modes including Brawl Mode, 2v2 Mode, and our helpful Practice Mode!

Note: In the “2v2” mode, if players choose “Quick matching” it can only accommodate 2 players (pair with 2 bots) or 4 players. There's no option for 3 players and 1 bot.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40377468/592a69053e041da7710fe7af715fc55acaf34412.png[/img]

And finally, our Space Station, where you can have some downtime between games and enjoy its facilities such as archery or basketball!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40377468/c9559870135eea14376d4ba7d9031dc0163543b8.png[/img]

So come join us in this mighty, melee-filled multiverse before November 4th, and be sure to step into our [url=https://discord.gg/cXXZthYg6e]Discord[/url] portal for in-game support, feedback, and much more.
